criteria.reasoning: The deliverables table reports D1 as "120 | 131 | Met", and the notes say "131 learners against a target of 120... Met."

D2 is reported as "94 of 131 = 71.8% | Not met". The memo notes "we needed at least 99 completers" and rejects Marcus's goal of 90 as using "the enrollment target (120) rather than actual enrollment (131)".
D3 is reported as "61 of 94 = 64.9% | Met". The memo explicitly rejects Marcus's 83.6% (61 of 73) as using the wrong denominator.
D4 is reported as "25 | 26 | Met", and the memo notes that "the report should say 26, not '27 tutors trained'" because the 27th tutor had only 8 hours.
D5 is reported as "3 (Q1, Q2 and Q3 only) | Not met", listing 2025-09-18, 2025-12-11 and 2026-03-19. The memo says the July 16 meeting "falls in Year 2, Q1. It cannot count toward Year 1 Q4."

The memo identifies "AP-2242, Harborview Taproom, 'beer and wine service,' $640.00" as prohibited alcohol that "must be moved to unrestricted funds". It excludes the charge from the adjusted actuals and totals. The catering charge is raised only as an item to confirm, not as the unallowable charge.
The table shows Learner supports as "$12,000 | $13,560 | +$1,560 | +13.0% | Yes | Needed; not obtained". The variance is over 10% and needs the Foundation's approval.

The table shows Curriculum & materials as "$8,000 | $6,920 | −$1,080 | −13.5% | Yes | Needed; not obtained". The memo stresses that "An underspend of more than 10% also triggers the approval requirement."
Every other line is marked "Not needed", and the memo says "Two budget lines are more than 10% off". Only Learner supports and Curriculum are flagged.

The memo gives Personnel −$1,020 (−1.5%, $66,980), Fringe −$204 (−1.5%, $13,396), Tutor training −$300 (−6.0%, $4,700), Local travel −$290 (−8.1%) and Evaluation $0 (0.0%). The +$340 tutor figure appears only as the unadjusted ledger reference, not as the memo's variance.

The memo reports "Allowable Year 1 spending $118,666.00" and "Unspent Year 1 funds $1,334.00", which carry forward to Year 2. Renee's $694 is described only as the pre-adjustment figure, with "The interim report should use the adjusted figure of $1,334.00."
The memo gives "August 14, 2026 | Interim report due (45 days after June 30, 2026)".
The memo lists "April 1, 2027 | Last day for the Foundation to receive any no-cost extension request (90 days before June 30, 2027)" and advises sending it well before then.
The memo lists "September 28, 2027 | Final report due (90 days after June 30, 2027), with any unspent funds returned". It also notes how the dates would shift if an extension is granted.
